profile.name: Sahil Kumar
profile.headline: I build software
profile.intro: Computer Science student. Developer. Exploring the space between useful software, thoughtful interfaces, and real-world problems.

about.title: Curious by nature.
paragraphs: I’m a Computer Science & Engineering student at M. Kumarasamy College of Engineering. I enjoy connecting thoughtful interfaces with solid application logic — and exploring how technology can solve practical problems.
My interests span full-stack development, relational databases, and computer vision. I’m especially interested in efficient, offline-first solutions for rural India.

projects.title: CampusMate
projects.description: An Android chat app for anonymous one-to-one conversations and topic-based group rooms, built with React, TypeScript, Capacitor, and Supabase.
details: Anonymous one-to-one matching with controls to find the next conversation or end a chat.
Topic-based group rooms with aliases, member lists, typing indicators, and unread-message controls.
Supabase authentication, database-backed matching, and realtime message updates.
Mobile interface packaged for Android with Capacitor, including keyboard and scrolling adjustments.
Reporting and blocking controls with age and privacy consent.

projects.title: Explainable Fall & SOS Screening
projects.description: A video screening pipeline designed to identify falls and SOS gestures in CCTV clips, with explainable predictions.
details: Samples frames at intervals to reduce computation while retaining event coverage.
Uses MediaPipe Pose and Hands with OpenCV to extract movement, posture, and gesture features.
Classifies segments as FALL, SOS, or NORMAL and uses temporal confirmation to reduce isolated false detections.
Uses SHAP to explain which pose and hand features contributed to predictions.

projects.title: Movie Ticket Booking System
projects.description: A relational database project for managing movies, theatres, showtimes, seats, and customer bookings.
details: Designed tables with appropriate primary keys, foreign keys, and constraints.
Implemented booking and seat reservation workflows with SQL joins.
Retrieves booking history and analyzes occupancy patterns with aggregate queries.

projects.title: Currency Exchange Calculator
projects.description: A practical currency conversion project with a simple HTML and CSS interface.
details: Converts between currencies through a focused calculator workflow.
Includes user account setup and access permissions.
Built as a hands-on project in application logic and interface design.
